title: Luscious Molten Irish Chicken Legs Stew
description: A hearty, one-pot Irish dish featuring chicken legs in a rich, winey mother-sauce-base, perfect for a cold evening. This low-glycemic-friendly stew is made with wholesome ingredients and is sure to become a favorite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken legs with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken legs on all sides, then remove them from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot, stirring to combine.
Return the chicken legs to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the stew for 30 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 250 degrees Fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 60 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the stew cool slightly before serving.
